# Eliana Nowlis

## Description

I am mainly trying to build my skills around making visualizations, and wanted
to pick data that will be fun and interesting. I think the tourism data will
have some surprising insights that I am excited to discover.

## Data Sources

### Data Source 1: UN Tourism

URL: https://www.untourism.int/tourism-statistics/tourism-statistics-database

Size: 197,778 rows, 14 columns

UN Tourism contains tourism statistics from countries and territories around the
world, from 1995 to 2024. The data was originally stored in separate excel files,
but I stacked them into one master dataset. The stacked data contains 151 different
indicators including things like total employment in tourism industries, number
of domestic trips, and average length of stay.

### Data Source 2: NFL Fantasy Data

URL: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/heefjones/nfl-fantasy-data-1970-2024/data

Size: 29,369 rows, 66 columns

NFL fantasy data from the 1970-2024 seasons. The data contains all players eligible
for fantasy scoring in a given season. Includes player, team, age, and a lot of
numeric data about their various metrics for that season.
